steps.name: Clues to a Memory (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Lapidem] on "Monster Tree Mountain", then travel through the "World Between Times" to find [Siam].

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: You've come to hear what I have to say.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're the second to mention it, after Asma.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: You may not know, but spirits come and go along certain currents. A few followed you all the way here.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: From what they tell me, that Shynic in Tartaros noticed you'd forgotten something, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why didn't she say anything?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: The spirit that followed you says... because it was a bother.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, that's Shynic. She wouldn't mention it if it was too much trouble.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That makes me wonder. What expression do people see that tells them I've lost memories?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: There's a great, strange emptiness about you. Mages with strong mana and those with primal power notice it right away. That's why I spoke up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So that empty feeling comes from missing memories?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I can't tell what memories you've lost. But I reckon I can help you recall them a little.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, thank you!

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I haven't lived all these years for nothing. Do you know someone named Siam? The one who defeated the Demon King with the goddess...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Siam... Yes, I know him.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Certain stars in the night sky showed me where he was. I sent wind spirits to hear his story, but it was no use.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: He seems to be in our world, but that hidden place is beyond my reach.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Goddess Seres once said memories remain when time and space are perceived together...

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Perhaps Siam, in that place where time and space are twisted, knows something...

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Go where he is. That space filled with emptiness.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Lapidem.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Helping someone marked with the spirits' trust is only natural. Go carefully, understood?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be going.

steps.name: Clues to a Memory (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Ixion] in the "Abyss Chamber" and obtain the <Hero's Gold Insignia>. Then report to [Siam].

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Welcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's been a while.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: I cannot tell how much time has passed here. But your presence feels greatly changed. Time must have moved on.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Have you perhaps...

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Met Iris?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. A great deal has happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain to Siam what happened after Vanaheim and how you finally met Iris.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: (Siam seems unable to speak.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: After Vanaheim, I couldn't sense her presence. I was deeply worried. To think she was in a temple filled with divine power and received strength from the goddess residing there...

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: I'm glad to have news of her, even like this. Yet it saddens me. Her cruel fate seems to continue...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. Everything will work out. Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Since you've come to see me here, something must be troubling you.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: It's all right. Tell me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain what people said about your expression and lost memories, and that the spirit Lapidem sent you here.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: How kind of him to perceive me and send you here... I can feel your emptiness, too. I don't know what it is. However...

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: I know a way that might awaken your memories, if only faintly.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Bring me a tool belonging to one of this world's great mages. The lingering thoughts within it may help...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Siam. I'll be back.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: A great mage's tool... I can sense the energy in its lingering thoughts. It isn't dangerous. You needn't watch from so far away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, all right. I'll come closer.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: It doesn't seem compatible with filling your emptiness. But our efforts weren't fruitless. I read a brief memory.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: The tool recalls a girl connected to the mage who once lost her memories. Fortunately, she seems to have recovered them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That girl would be...)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Learn her method. If you follow it, you may recover your lost memories, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you! That helps.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Someone I know who was connected to that mage...)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: And when you can, please give my thanks to the spirit and my regards to Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. Actually, perhaps you can greet Iris now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris, Iris. If you can hear me, let us hear your voice.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No response.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: It's all right. A message from Iris will take considerable time to reach this place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even so...

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: She will become a perfect goddess with magnificent power... It was good to see you. May good fortune fill your days.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you again, Siam. I'll be going.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: (Once %s disappears, Siam takes the mage's tool in hand to destroy it.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: ...Hmm? Another person's memories remain. How unusual.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: There seem to be memories of someone else within this tool... An outsider who came to this world bearing a certain fate...

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: From the same world as me, or one much like it...

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Why would someone once so righteous choose to become evil...?

steps.name: Clues to a Memory (4)
steps.objective: Defeat [Veska] in the "Jewel Tree Forest" and obtain a <Tear of Light>. Then report to [Shynic] in "Underground City Tartaros".

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You. I told you to rest in Tartaros, didn't I? Where have you been wandering?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, you see...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Wait! I smell something. Sniff, sniff.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You've met a spirit and a mage with unusual powers, haven't you? Still no match for me, though.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I did meet them, but I don't intend to fight you. I have a question instead.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What? If it's boring, I won't lift a finger.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An expression that suggests lost memories...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You have definitely lost memories. Your silly face tells me so. An expression full of emptiness...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought you were just teasing me about my looks.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I wouldn't joke about that. Hehe. I simply didn't bother paying attention.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: So you want to know what you've forgotten?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rather than what the memories contain, I'd like to know how to recover them.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hmm... Sounds bothersome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Of course...)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: But it might be fun, so I'll tell you. I owe you, too.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: When was it...? Oh, right. During the Dark War, I came to covered in blood, with my memories gone.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Several villages lay in ruins. People practically called me a demon. But I couldn't remember anything.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: All because of that old bastard... Anyway, the ancient dragon Gluart in the Jewel Tree Forest helped me.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I recovered my memories with 'Tears of Light,' called the fruit of the jewel trees. I don't know if you can still find them.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You'll need two. One won't do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. I'll be right back.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Good. This should be fun. Look forward to it. ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Urgh... What exactly am I supposed to look forward to?)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: The Jewel Tree Forest isn't easy to enter. You managed well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shynic! I brought the Tears of Light!

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Good work. Just as radiant and beautiful as they were back then.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If I'd been a little later, I might never have found a clue about them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: As soon as Ziskad became a Champion, he slew the ancient dragon Gluart. He said he was destroying a threat to humanity, but...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: No, never mind. Ask him yourself. Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (There's more to this that I don't know.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: These are special. They need purification, or they'll cause trouble. Wait a moment.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: (Shynic holds the Tears of Light and closes her eyes. Soon the gems tremble in resonance with her mana.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: There. Done.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do I do now?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Eat them. ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Eat them. Didn't you hear? I'll say it again. Swallow. ♡

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Adventurer, taking them dry will be bad for you. I've brought water.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That's my butler. ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-wait. Melvic, where did you come from?!

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Melvic.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You sense something suspicious passing between Shynic and Melvic.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hold them!

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: (At Shynic's order, Melvic steps behind %s and seizes both hands. Struggling does little to loosen his grip.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-wait. Melvic... What are you? Ugh, that strength... You're not a butler, are you?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Merely an ordinary butler. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Open wide. Aah~ Here's a Tear of Light. I purified it to make it easy to eat, so you'd better swallow. Or I'll kill you. ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A-all right. I'll eat it. One first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A Tear of Light enters your mouth. Surprisingly chewy, it releases a distinctive, refreshing aroma.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's just like... Wait, this isn't the time for food reviews. Better take the other one. Gulp.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I ate them. Why does my head keep hurting...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Your mind grows hazy, then clear again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this feeling...?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Only a mild headache. Good. I thought I was dying when I took them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: The pain matched the weight of the memories. Yours weren't such a large amount, it seems. Though that doesn't mean they were trivial.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Memories erased deliberately are usually important.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Now you only need to realize them. My part is done. Get help from the other Champions for the rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Thank you, Shynic.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Just repaying a debt. I also want to see how far the Goddess's Executioner will go. Hehe. It was fun, so that's enough.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: %s, Shynic says she had fun. How long it's been since I heard that... (Moved.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Melvic, don't look so happy over this. It's embarrassing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll return to my lodgings and rest. Call me when it's time.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Soon enough. Look forward to it. ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, God. Please don't look forward to this.)
